Even though memory costs are expected to easily become the most expensive part of the iPhone 18 Pro bill of materials, the same may not hold true for the iPhone Duo. Here's the rundown.

Apple signs three-year exclusive supply deal with Samsung Display

Leaker Instant Digital claimed in a post on Weibo this morning that Apple has signed a three-year exclusive supply agreement with Samsung Display for foldable panels.

According to the tipster, Samsung Display will be the exclusive supplier of foldable panels for the iPhone Duo “and later models,” with each panel costing around $250.

The leaker also pointed out that the panel is “unsurprisingly” one of the most expensive core components of the device.

While no reliable information has emerged regarding the expected bill of materials for the iPhone Duo, by breaking down the cost structure of the display, camera, processor, memory and other components, Apple has shared interesting information about the materials used in the device, including the proportion of recycled materials it contains.
